Break- ing down a business problem into key questions that can be answered through analytics, Charac- teristics of good questions, Skills of a good business analyst, The Basic Tools of Business Analytics - Data exploration and visualization (using tools like Excel, Tableau, or Power BI), Concept of Statis- tical analysis and hypothesis testing (Hypothesis testing numerical / tests not expected) Data Visu- alization: Concept of Data Visualization, Popular Data Visualization tools, Exploratory Data Analysis (EDA), Data Cleaning, Data Inspection.

units.title: Predictive and Prescriptive Analytics
units.topics: Trend Lines, Regression Analysis Linear & Multiple, Predictive modeling, forecasting Techniques, Data Mining - Definition, Approaches in Data Mining- Data Exploration & Reduction, Data mining and business intelligence, Data mining for business, Classification, Association, Cause Effect Model- ing, Overview of Linear Optimization, Non-Linear Programming Integer Optimization, Cutting Plane algorithm and other methods, Decision Analysis Risk and uncertainty methods - Text analytics Web analytics.

units.title: Business Analytics in Marketing and Finance
units.topics: Marketing Analytics, Customer segmentation, targeting, and positioning, Campaign management and ROI measurement, Data-driven marketing strategies. Financial Analytics - Risk management and credit scoring, financial forecasting and planning, Case studies: Financial performance improvement through analytics (Non-Statistical - Conceptual Treatment only).

units.topics: Mobile Journalism content, Mobile apps for reporting. Audio and video mobile applications, Script Writing and Presentation skills multi-media content management, managing social media, Impact of Mobile on Society

Platforms Of Media, Future of MoJo reporting, Mobile Regulation authorities , TRAI,MIB,AIMCR, Ethics in Mobile Journalism, Citizen Journalism.
